description: Defines internal low-level scheduling mechanisms and the SchedulingGuard class for controlling cooperative rescheduling in the Abseil library.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard
classes.description: Provides guard semantics to disable and enable cooperative rescheduling of the calling thread within specific code regions.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard::ScopedDisable
classes.description: Scoped helper to disable rescheduling within a code block.

classes.name: SchedulingGuard::ScopedEnable
classes.description: Scoped helper to temporarily enable rescheduling.

methods.name: ReschedulingIsAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether the calling thread may be cooperatively rescheduled.

methods.name: DisableRescheduling
methods.description: Disables cooperative rescheduling of the calling thread.

methods.name: ScopedEnable::ScopedEnable
methods.description: Constructor for ScopedEnable, initializes the disabled depth.

methods.name: ScopedEnable::~ScopedEnable
methods.description: Destructor for ScopedEnable, checks that disable depth is zero.
